Shiny Server Module for Non-Blocking Micro-Pilot and HPC Submission

Source: R/shiny_submit.R
mod_hpc_submit_server.Rd

Runs micro-pilot trials asynchronously in background OS child processes polled via shiny::reactiveTimer() so the Shiny session remains 100% responsive, estimates optimal SLURM flags via estimate_resources(), and submits jobs to backend via slurm_submit().

Usage

mod_hpc_submit_server(
  id,
  backend,
  fun,
  args_builder,
  packages = character(),
  globals = list(),
  seed = 101L,
  poll_ms = 150L,
  async_pilot = TRUE
)

Arguments

id

Character module namespace ID matching mod_hpc_submit_ui().

backend

A SlurmBackend object (or a reactive returning one).

fun

Worker function fun(arg) (or a reactive returning one).

args_builder

Function function(n_tasks) returning an args_list of length n_tasks (or a reactive returning such a function).

packages

Character vector of worker packages (or reactive).

globals

Named list of worker globals (or reactive).

seed

Optional integer base seed (or reactive).

poll_ms

Polling interval in milliseconds for non-blocking background micro-pilot progress. Default 150L.

async_pilot

Logical; if TRUE (default), runs micro-pilot trials in non-blocking background callr::r_bg processes driven by reactiveTimer. Set FALSE only for synchronous unit testing.

Value

A named list of reactives:

  • job: latest submitted slurmpilot_job handle (or NULL).

  • pilot: latest slurmpilot_pilot result (or NULL).

  • resources: latest slurmpilot_resources plan (or NULL).

  • is_piloting: logical reactive indicating an active background pilot.

See also

mod_hpc_submit_ui(), mod_hpc_monitor_server()

Examples

# \donttest{
if (interactive() && requireNamespace("shiny", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("bslib", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ui <- bslib::page_fluid(mod_hpc_submit_ui("sub"))
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    be <- mock_slurm_backend(max_workers = 2L)
    mod_hpc_submit_server(
      "sub",
      backend = be,
      fun = function(x) x^2,
      args_builder = function(n) as.list(seq_len(n))
    )
  }
  shiny::shinyApp(ui, server)
}
# }
